parameters.query:
WITH inserido AS (
    INSERT INTO public.eventos_processados (
        idempotency_key,
        correlation_id,
        agente,
        origem,
        obra_codigo,
        status,
        payload_hash
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2::uuid,
        'AGENTE_00',
        'WHATSAPP',
        $3,
        'PROCESSANDO',
        $4
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING
        id,
        idempotency_key,
        correlation_id,
        obra_codigo,
        status,
        payload_hash,
        criado_em
),

existente_atualizado AS (
    UPDATE public.eventos_processados AS e
    SET
        obra_codigo = COALESCE(e.obra_codigo, $3),
        payload_hash = COALESCE(e.payload_hash, $4),
        atualizado_em = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE e.idempotency_key = $1
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inserido
      )
    RETURNING
        e.id,
        e.idempotency_key,
        e.correlation_id,
        e.obra_codigo,
        e.status,
        e.payload_hash,
        e.criado_em
)

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        i.id AS evento_id,
        i.idempotency_key,
        i.correlation_id::text AS correlation_id_evento,
        i.obra_codigo,
        i.payload_hash,
        $5::text AS tipo_entrada,
        $6::text AS mensagem,
        i.status AS evento_status,
        i.criado_em AS evento_criado_em,
        TRUE AS evento_novo
    FROM inserido AS i

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        e.id AS evento_id,
        e.idempotency_key,
        e.correlation_id::text AS correlation_id_evento,
        e.obra_codigo,
        e.payload_hash,
        $5::text AS tipo_entrada,
        $6::text AS mensagem,
        e.status AS evento_status,
        e.criado_em AS evento_criado_em,
        FALSE AS evento_novo
    FROM existente_atualizado AS e
) AS resultado
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE public.eventos_processados
SET
    status = 'CONCLUIDO',
    atualizado_em = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    concluido_em = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    mensagem_erro = NULL
WHERE idempotency_key = $1
RETURNING
    id AS evento_id,
    idempotency_key,
    correlation_id::text AS correlation_id,
    obra_codigo,
    status AS evento_status,
    concluido_em,
    COALESCE($2::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS resposta_final;
